title: The ClickHouse starter template on Forgejo: /yodel rebase on a fork two merged branches make, refused when main moves while it runs

steps.title: feat: a memos table
steps.label: its migration follows the same parent as the note's
main now has the note's migration, so the memo's forks with it
the author asks for the rebase
main moves after the command ran on the base it merged, before the push lands
the base moved, so the merge of a stale base is not pushed

break.note: The push jobs land without the moved-base check (CHANT_COMMIT_HARNESS_BREAK=moved-base, BREAK=1, on the Forgejo push jobs only), so the merge of the base the command ran on is pushed although main moved, and the memo-refused step's reply says pushed.
